narrationTexts: Confirms the bug: `orderTotal` taxes the pre-discount amount instead of the discounted amount.
finalText:
**Fixed. Suite is green.**

`orderTotal` in [pricing.js:41](src/pricing.js:41) taxed the pre-discount amount. Tax should apply to what the customer actually pays.

Changed `tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate)` to use `discounted` instead of `cents`.
